headlines.description: — Franz Wagner fell a rebound shy of his first career triple-double, scoring 35 points and adding 12 assists to lead the Orlando Magic to their first home victory, 107-99 over the Milwaukee Bucks on Friday night in NBA Cup play.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wagner falls a rebound shy of a triple-double in the Magic's 107-99 win over the Bucks
